title: Vulkan STORAGE_IMAGE descriptor bindings required for UAV compute shaders
content: Vulkan descriptor set layout must include STORAGE_IMAGE bindings for compute shader UAVs (RWTexture2D). UzEngine had 48 bindings (16 tex + 16 sampler + 16 CB) but zero UAV bindings. Added bindings 48-63 as VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_IMAGE and `-fvk-u-shift 48 0` to DXC SPIR-V compilation so HLSL `register(u0)` maps to Vulkan binding 48. Without this, compute shaders writing to UAVs silently fail.
